name: Acceptance suite-3 test 74b - wildcard ASSUME scope covers a concrete modify/trust role (mirror of test 74)
note: IAM-1006 (Phase 10, iteration 4) adversarial finding: the exact MIRROR of test 74. Test 74 is a WILDCARD modify leg + a CONCRETE assume leg; this is a CONCRETE permission-grant/trust-modify leg naming arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/deployment/Prod plus a BOUNDED wildcard assume (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/deployment/*) that provably covers it. All three legs reach the same concrete role, so the compound must yield exactly ONE critical ROLE-TAKEOVER anchored on deployment/Prod - identical to its forward mirror. The engine previously harvested anchor roles ONLY from concrete ASSUME-leg ARNs, so a role named only by a modify/trust leg was never anchored and the critical path was missed (a false negative). The bounded wildcard assume ALSO stands as its own ASSUME-ROLE-EXPANSION row; the maximally-broad *:role/* case (role-takeover.test.js test 142) still stays expansion-only, never a same-role takeover.
